cert_project_submission_dates_order.name: cert_project_submission_dates_order
cert_project_submission_dates_order.value: "cert_project"."submitted_at" IS NULL OR "cert_project"."accepted_at" IS NULL OR "cert_project"."accepted_at" >= "cert_project"."submitted_at"

conversation_goal_requires_project.name: conversation_goal_requires_project
conversation_goal_requires_project.value: "conversation"."goal_id" IS NULL OR "conversation"."project_id" IS NOT NULL

document_void_reason_consistent.name: document_void_reason_consistent
document_void_reason_consistent.value: (NOT "document"."voided" AND "document"."void_reason" IS NULL) OR ("document"."voided" AND "document"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("document"."void_reason")) > 0)

document_parse_task_lease.name: document_parse_task_lease
document_parse_task_lease.value:
("document_parse_task"."state" = 'running' AND "document_parse_task"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "document_parse_task"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL) OR
      ("document_parse_task"."state" <> 'running' AND "document_parse_task"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "document_parse_task"."lease_until" IS NULL)

entity_role_validity_order.name: entity_role_validity_order
entity_role_validity_order.value: "entity_role"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "entity_role"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "entity_role"."valid_until" >= "entity_role"."valid_from"

external_model_exchange_state.name: external_model_exchange_state
external_model_exchange_state.value:
("external_model_exchange"."status"='settled' AND "external_model_exchange"."actual_nano" IS NOT NULL AND ("external_model_exchange"."answer" IS NULL OR "external_model_exchange"."returned" IS NOT NULL))
      OR ("external_model_exchange"."status" IN ('reserved','unknown','awaiting_receipt') AND "external_model_exchange"."actual_nano" IS NULL AND "external_model_exchange"."answer" IS NULL
          AND ("external_model_exchange"."status"<>'awaiting_receipt' OR ("external_model_exchange"."dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL AND "external_model_exchange"."returned" IS NULL)))
      OR ("external_model_exchange"."status"='not_sent' AND "external_model_exchange"."actual_nano" IS NOT NULL AND "external_model_exchange"."actual_nano"=0 AND "external_model_exchange"."answer" IS NULL)

fact_revision_ok.name: fact_revision_ok
fact_revision_ok.value: ("fact"."revision" = 1 AND "fact"."replaces_id" IS NULL) OR ("fact"."revision" > 1 AND "fact"."replaces_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fact"."replaces_id" <> "fact"."id")

fact_candidate_decision_ok.name: fact_candidate_decision_ok
fact_candidate_decision_ok.value: ("fact_candidate"."status" IN ('pending','cancelled') AND "fact_candidate"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "fact_candidate"."decided_at" IS NULL) OR ("fact_candidate"."status" IN ('confirmed','rewritten','rejected') AND "fact_candidate"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "fact_candidate"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

intake_job_lease.name: intake_job_lease
intake_job_lease.value:
("intake_job"."state" = 'running' AND "intake_job"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "intake_job"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL) OR
    ("intake_job"."state" <> 'running' AND "intake_job"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "intake_job"."lease_until" IS NULL)

role_binding_scope_consistent.name: role_binding_scope_consistent
role_binding_scope_consistent.value: ("legacy_role_binding"."scope_type" = 'project' AND "legacy_role_binding"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("legacy_role_binding"."scope_type" IN ('global', 'own') AND "legacy_role_binding"."scope_id" IS NULL)

outbound_message_receipt_complete.name: outbound_message_receipt_complete
outbound_message_receipt_complete.value: "outbound_message"."receipt_id" IS NULL OR "outbound_message"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL

review_decision_snapshot_required.name: review_decision_snapshot_required
review_decision_snapshot_required.value: ("review_decision"."action" = 'approved' AND "review_decision"."snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("review_decision"."action" = 'rejected' AND "review_decision"."snapshot_id" IS NULL)

rule_pack_version_publication_ok.name: rule_pack_version_publication_ok
rule_pack_version_publication_ok.value: ("rule_pack_version"."publication" = 'development' AND "rule_pack_version"."published_by" IS NULL) OR ("rule_pack_version"."publication" = 'published' AND "rule_pack_version"."published_by" IS NOT NULL)

run_goal_requires_project.name: run_goal_requires_project
run_goal_requires_project.value: "run"."goal_id" IS NULL OR "run"."project_id" IS NOT NULL

run_lease_complete.name: run_lease_complete
run_lease_complete.value: ("run"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "run"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("run"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "run"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "run"."lease_generation" > 0)

run_event_sandbox_hashes.name: run_event_sandbox_hashes
run_event_sandbox_hashes.value:
("run_event"."sandbox_input_hashes" IS NULL AND "run_event"."sandbox_output_hashes" IS NULL) OR (
        "run_event"."type" = 'tool_completed' AND "run_event"."invocation_id" IS NOT NULL AND
        "run_event"."content_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "run_event"."duration_ms" IS NOT NULL AND
        "run_event"."sandbox_input_hashes" IS NOT NULL AND "run_event"."sandbox_output_hashes" IS NOT NULL AND
        array_to_string("run_event"."sandbox_input_hashes", ',', '?') ~ '^([0-9a-f]{64}(,[0-9a-f]{64}){0,15})?$' AND
        array_to_string("run_event"."sandbox_output_hashes", ',', '?') ~ '^([0-9a-f]{64}(,[0-9a-f]{64}){0,31})?$'
      )

run_steering_message_delivery_complete.name: run_steering_message_delivery_complete
run_steering_message_delivery_complete.value: ("run_steering_message"."delivered_message_id" IS NULL AND "run_steering_message"."delivered_seq" IS NULL AND "run_steering_message"."delivered_at" IS NULL AND "run_steering_message"."delivered_generation" IS NULL) OR ("run_steering_message"."delivered_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "run_steering_message"."delivered_seq">0 AND "run_steering_message"."delivered_seq"<=9007199254740991 AND "run_steering_message"."delivered_at" IS NOT NULL AND "run_steering_message"."delivered_generation">0 AND "run_steering_message"."delivered_generation"<=9007199254740991)

skill_release_active.name: skill_release_active
skill_release_active.value: CASE WHEN "skill_release"."action" = 'disable' THEN "skill_release"."active_version_id" IS NULL ELSE "skill_release"."active_version_id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "skill_release"."target_version_id" END

skill_rollback_target.name: skill_rollback_target
skill_rollback_target.value:
("skill_rollback_proposal"."status" NOT IN ('pending','approved') OR "skill_rollback_proposal"."target_version_id" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("skill_rollback_proposal"."status"<>'notice' OR "skill_rollback_proposal"."target_version_id" IS NULL)

skill_rollback_audit_fields.name: skill_rollback_audit_fields
skill_rollback_audit_fields.value:
(("skill_rollback_proposal"."status" IN ('approved','dismissed'))
    AND "skill_rollback_proposal"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_rollback_proposal"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_rollback_proposal"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_rollback_proposal"."request_key" IS NOT NULL)
    OR (("skill_rollback_proposal"."status" NOT IN ('approved','dismissed'))
    AND "skill_rollback_proposal"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "skill_rollback_proposal"."session_id" IS NULL AND "skill_rollback_proposal"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "skill_rollback_proposal"."request_key" IS NULL)

skill_version_metadata_identity.name: skill_version_metadata_identity
skill_version_metadata_identity.value: ("skill_version"."metadata"->>'id') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "skill_version"."skill_id" AND ("skill_version"."metadata"->>'version') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "skill_version"."version"

undo_record_state_consistent.name: undo_record_state_consistent
undo_record_state_consistent.value: ("undo_record"."status" = 'pending' AND "undo_record"."after_version" IS NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_version" IS NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_at" IS NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_by" IS NULL) OR ("undo_record"."status" = 'available' AND "undo_record"."after_version" IS NOT NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_version" IS NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_at" IS NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_by" IS NULL) OR ("undo_record"."status" = 'undone' AND "undo_record"."after_version" IS NOT NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_version" IS NOT NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_at" IS NOT NULL AND "undo_record"."undone_by" IS NOT NULL)

usage_ledger_cache_tokens_safe.name: usage_ledger_cache_tokens_safe
usage_ledger_cache_tokens_safe.value: "usage_ledger"."cache_read_tokens" IS NULL OR ("usage_ledger"."cache_read_tokens" >= 0 AND "usage_ledger"."cache_read_tokens" <= 9007199254740991 AND ("usage_ledger"."input_tokens" IS NULL OR "usage_ledger"."cache_read_tokens" <= "usage_ledger"."input_tokens"))

usage_ledger_state_consistent.name: usage_ledger_state_consistent
usage_ledger_state_consistent.value:
("usage_ledger"."status" = 'reserved' AND NOT "usage_ledger"."settled_by_estimate" AND "usage_ledger"."actual_nano" IS NULL AND "usage_ledger"."settlement_fingerprint" IS NULL)
          OR ("usage_ledger"."status" = 'settled' AND "usage_ledger"."actual_nano" IS NOT NULL AND "usage_ledger"."settlement_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL
              AND ((NOT "usage_ledger"."settled_by_estimate" AND "usage_ledger"."input_tokens" IS NOT NULL AND "usage_ledger"."cache_read_tokens" IS NOT NULL AND "usage_ledger"."output_tokens" IS NOT NULL)
                   OR ("usage_ledger"."settled_by_estimate" AND "usage_ledger"."actual_nano" = "usage_ledger"."reserved_nano" AND "usage_ledger"."input_tokens" IS NULL AND "usage_ledger"."cache_read_tokens" IS NULL AND "usage_ledger"."output_tokens" IS NULL)))
          OR ("usage_ledger"."status" = 'unknown' AND NOT "usage_ledger"."settled_by_estimate" AND "usage_ledger"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("usage_ledger"."status" = 'not_sent' AND NOT "usage_ledger"."settled_by_estimate" AND ("usage_ledger"."actual_nano" IS NULL OR "usage_ledger"."actual_nano" = 0))

verification_link_kind.name: verification_link_kind
verification_link_kind.value: ("verification_link"."kind"='agent' AND "verification_link"."review_id" IS NULL) OR ("verification_link"."kind"='review' AND "verification_link"."review_id" IS NOT NULL)

workspace_draft_file_tombstone.name: workspace_draft_file_tombstone
workspace_draft_file_tombstone.value: ("workspace_draft_file"."is_deleted" AND "workspace_draft_file"."sha256" IS NULL AND "workspace_draft_file"."byte_size" IS NULL) OR (NOT "workspace_draft_file"."is_deleted" AND "workspace_draft_file"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_draft_file"."byte_size" IS NOT NULL)
